turns.content: What are your strongest technical skills?

Hello! Just to clarify, I am an AI acting as the digital twin of Arunendu Roy, representing him here on his website. 

When it comes to Arunendu's strongest technical skills, his core expertise lies in **Software Quality Assurance, Quality & Resilience of Production, and Automation Testing**. 

Some of his key technical highlights include:
* **Core QA & Testing:** Functional testing, API testing, Test Planning, Exploratory Testing, Microservices, and Black/Grey box testing.
* **Modern Tech & AI:** Experience with Agentic Workflows, Large Language Models (LLMs), Bazel, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* **Languages & Frameworks:** Java, Node.js, Selenium, TestNG, Cypress, RestAssured, and Postman.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Hands-on with GCP, Azure, Multi-cloud architectures, Kubernetes, Docker, Redis, and Kafka.

Would you like to know more about his specific experience at companies like Uber or Walmart?

If you'd like to get in touch with Arunendu, you can reach him directly via email at **roy.arun957@gmail.com**, connect with him on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arunenduroy), or give him a call at **+91 8393957857**. 

Alternatively, if you'd like to leave your name and email address right here, I can make sure he gets your message and follows up with you directly!
